title: Scaffold volumetric path: HDR UAV, 3D density texture, composite
purpose: Lay groundwork for volumetric rendering with an HDR target and a 3D density resource, plus a debug slice and composite stage.

steps.detail: Allocate R16G16B16A16_FLOAT UAV as intermediate HDR; add fullscreen composite to swapchain.
Create 3D texture R16_FLOAT (SRV/UAV) with configurable dims (e.g., 192–256 cubed) and a clear pass.
Add compute shader to write a test pattern into HDR and to visualize a slice of density as color.
Recreate HDR and dependent resources on resize; validate transitions in PIX.

acceptance: Density slice debug visible and bounds-correct
references: Microsoft Learn – UAV and barrier usage in D3D12
DirectX Graphics Samples – Post-processing and fullscreen passes
